summary: Completed all 10 plan phases: created scripts/lib/phase-heading-patterns.sh as the single sourced anchor for the phase-heading grammar/enum/non-conformance detector, migrated ~19 regex sites across 11 files onto it, and settled D1/D2/D3 as recorded decisions. Full repository gate set passes (bash -n, 35/35 fixture suite, check-task-references.sh, check-extension-docs.sh modulo 2 pre-existing unrelated literature-extension findings).
decisions_made: D1: letter-suffixed sub-phases (Phase 3a) stay UNSUPPORTED; the silent-undercount hole is closed by loud, named non-conforming-heading detection at every site instead of widening the grammar.
D2: [DESCOPED] is REJECTED as a phase-heading marker; whole-phase descoping uses [COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS] with a full #### Reasoned Exclusions record.
D3: non-conformance is inconclusive-and-loud (pass-through with named per-heading warnings), never a hard refusal, except under validate-artifact.sh --strict where it is an error.

Added has_nonconforming_phase_headings to the library (Phase 4 deviation): the originally-planned 'nonconforming_phase_headings | grep -q .' idiom is racy under set -o pipefail (SIGPIPE on early grep -q exit); retrofitted across all call sites.

Fixed a check-extension-docs.sh basename-matching bug (Phase 10 deviation): its cross-extension-reference check compared bare filenames against path-prefixed provides.scripts entries verbatim, never matching lib/-or tests/-scoped scripts referenced by bare name in prose.
